source.publication: Income Tax in Nevada, Nevada Department of Taxation
source.section: 'Income Tax in Nevada' page, second sentence of the body text: Nevada has no personal income tax (no state return or form lines exist)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 100,000.00 + interest 3,000.00 = 103,000.00. Federal taxable income = 103,000.00 - 15,750.00 single standard deduction = 87,250.00 (given, not tested). Nevada imposes no personal income tax, so there is no state return: state taxable income 0.00, tax before credits 0.00, credits 0.00, state income tax 0.00 regardless of income.
